content.title: NETWORK & PORT DOCUMENTATION
content.content:
All required network ports are documented in SnapLogic's Groundplex Configuration Guide, provided to AH's network team prior to deployment. The primary connectivity requirement is a single outbound HTTPS/WSS connection (port 443) from each Ground Plex node to SnapLogic's Manager endpoint. No inbound ports are required on the AH network perimeter.
